title: DIAL-SUMMER: A Structured Evaluation Framework of Hierarchical Errors in Dialogue Summaries

bias_targets.methodology: Human annotation of generated dialogue summaries using a specific error category ('Speaker Identity Bias') to detect whether the summarizer makes unwarranted assumptions about a speaker's demographic identity (e.g., gender, race) that were not present in the source text.

Statistical analysis and human annotation of 'Missed Turn' errors to identify whether the summarizer disproportionately ignores certain parts of the source conversation based on their sequential position (e.g., beginning, middle, or end).
